_comment: Curated-label sidecar for the m00 test fixture, and the EXAMPLE of the format matter authors ship as data/matters/<slug>/personas/topic-labels.json. Each value is a short (3-6 word) LEAK-SAFE topic label: it names the SUBJECT a student could have explored, never the fact's content (debrief-oracle rule). tools/build_worker_personas.py prefers these over its content-free placeholders.
m00.fact.002: the slip in the produce aisle
m00.fact.003: what she was doing just before
m00.fact.005: any warning sign near the spill
m00.fact.007: the store's response after the fall
m00.fact.013: the effect on her work and income
